text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 25,227.95, down 0.63% on the day and 0.81% over the past five sessions, while the broader Nifty 500 fell 0.81%. Advances were limited to 119 stocks against 375 decliners, giving a breadth score of 69.2 (healthy) but showing a narrow rally. The India VIX held steady at 15.52, indicating low volatility after an 11.6% drop over five days.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers, adding INR 5,866.78 cr today and a five‑day total of INR 28,493.99 cr, while Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold INR 3,159.9 cr. The FII streak is now 15 days of buying. In the sector map, PSU banks, media and private banks led, whereas IT and commodities lagged. Options data show a put‑call ratio of 0.85 for Nifty (bullish bias) with max‑pain at 25,050 and a call wall at 26,000; Bank Nifty’s PCR is 1.18 (slightly bearish) with max‑pain at 60,000 and a call wall at 62,000.

Watch the Nifty support at 25,116 (S1) and resistance at 25,365 (R1). A break below 25,116 could test the 24,000 put wall, while a move above 25,365 may target the 26,000 call wall. For Bank Nifty, key levels are 61,748 (S1) and 62,346 (R1); a breach of 62,000 could trigger further buying in banks. Keep an eye on upcoming RBI reverse‑repo auction and any profit‑booking cues from corporate results.
